request.spec:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each user now has a locale, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**Where it's stored:** a new `user_locale` table (migration `V73__user_locale.sql`) keeps one locale per user name, shared across all sheets. A user with no row gets `en`. `GET` and `PUT /api/users/{user}/locale` read and save it; anything other than `en` or `de` is refused with a 400. Saving it writes no audit line.

**On screen:** next to "Signed in as" there is the current locale (`user-locale-current`), a select (`user-locale`) and a save button (`user-locale-save`). It stays put when you load another sheet.

**How figures switch to 1.234,56:** I didn't change every place a figure is drawn (there are dozens across about 6,500 lines of front end). Instead, one wrapper around the signed-in screen (`features/locale/LocaleFigures.tsx`) watches what's displayed. Under `de`, it rewrites any element whose whole text is a number with two decimals, and does it again whenever that text changes. It remembers the original, so switching back to `en` restores it. Because it works this way:
- Text boxes, selects and dropdown options are never touched, so entries are still typed with a dot.
- A figure sitting inside a longer sentence is left alone, as the request's rule says.
- Exports and audit lines are built from the data, not the screen, so they're unchanged.

The trade-off is that it changes the page after React has drawn it rather than formatting each value in the code. It covers every figure, including ones added later, without touching each one. If you'd rather format each value in the code, the conversion is a small function (`showFigure` in `features/locale/figures.ts`) that could be called at each place instead.

**One change outside the request:** scenario 2 failed every time, and not because of the locale. A viewer presses "generate plan claims" when there's nothing to make, and the spec expects them to be told `0`. The server refused all viewers up front. I changed `plans/generate` so a viewer is refused (with the same "A viewer can change nothing." error) only when there is a claim to make. Nothing is stored before that refusal. This changes what viewers get from that button, so check it's what you want.
